The '''Souls room''' is shown to the Keeper by [[Euric]]. This room contains workstations used to extract, heal and release the souls of [[Corpse|Corpses]].

You will need to repair all machines in the room before you can properly complete a soul cleansing procedure. A fresh body is placed in the [[Soul extractor]], generating a harmed soul. The soul decays much more quickly than the body, and it decays in the [[Corpse]] as well. To reduce this decay the souls can be stored in Soul containers.

The [[Harmed soul]] is placed in the [[Soul healer]], which uses [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] (starting with [[Flesh]] and unlocking receptacles for other [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] to cleanse specific sins) to make a [[Healed soul]]. The [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] are not used up. If the [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] match the [[Harmed soul]]'s requirements, it will result in a [[Healed soul]] in a higher condition. This also generates a number of [[Sin Shard]]s based on the number of sins cleansed (the number of [[Items#Bodyparts|body parts]] used).

The [[Healed soul]] then is put into the [[Soul portal]] and delivered safely into the afterlife, generating Soul Gratitude based on how much the soul has decayed. Gratitude is used to unlock new [[technologies]] in the new [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Spiritualism Tech Tree]], and can be used in conjunction with [[Soul Receiver]]s to remotely use crafting stations from the updated [[map]]. 

Finally, the [[Sin Shard]]s can be used on the [[Organ Workbench]] to upgrade any [[Items#Bodyparts|body part]] except [[Bone]], [[Skull]] up to 3 {{Skull|white}} and/or 3 {{Skull|red}} skulls. They can also be stored in the Soul Containers, and directly increase maximum souls' gratitude while there. 

The currently known highest souls' gratitude set up is 2086{{Souls Room Capacity}}, with a fully upgraded Soul Extractor adding 30{{Souls Room Capacity}}, the Soul Healer adding 15{{Souls Room Capacity}}, two Wall Crematoriums adding 20{{Souls Room Capacity}}, a Workbench adding 5{{Souls Room Capacity}}, six Pallet adding 6{{Souls Room Capacity}}, 3 Soul Container III's filled with gold quality items that stack to 50 (such as quality crops or seeds) stored, each adding 620{{Souls Room Capacity}}, and gold quality items that stack to 50 stored in Smiler's container, adding 150{{Souls Room Capacity}} when it becomes open.  

More is possible using a glitch: When placing a structure, if the player double clicks instead of a single click, the player is able to place the structure twice instead of once. Set up is shown below. 

'''Broken glass''' is a byproduct of breaking down old broken bottles in the [[Souls room]]. 

There is a [[Faceted diamond]] vein near the [[Soul portal]]. 
[[File:Set up.png|thumb|center|420px|A Souls room with more gratitude than it should be using the glitch]]<br />

==Workstations==

Workstations are built using the workbench called "Souls". To unlock blueprints for the Souls room, you need the normal [[Technologies#Technology_points|tech points]], but also Soul Gratitude, obtained by healing souls. Building each piece of equipment will increase the room's gratitude capacity ({{Souls Room Capacity}}) by a set amount.
